title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Battle Pass System, BlackCell, and New Store Bundles
author: COD Official
contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/29a51de8460d9ebb11602464b315956cb4a50c31.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell: 50+ Guaranteed Rewards!*[/h2][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass is packed with 100+ Rewards, including a brand-new catch-up system that guarantees 50+ rewards in the Battle Pass*. In addition to the normal unlocking of Battle Pass content, players who fall behind in the Battle Pass will be automatically caught up to the Reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50.[/p][p]*Requires a paid Battle Pass.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b0506a20b29af07e0247eff0182d716754bfb6fe.jpg"][/img]The Battle Pass itself is easier to navigate: Log in to collect your rewards and keep playing to unlock an easy-to-follow 100-tier track filled with additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves, Calling Cards, Weapon Charms, Reticles, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]How Do I Purchase the Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Battle Pass?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b54c023733b3e10be8c5d1a5a8a00a1088149d29.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass in one of four different ways:[/p][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass:[/b] For 1,100 COD Points, receive access to the Season 1 Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass Bundle:[/b] For 2,400 COD Points, receive access to the Season 1 Battle Pass, plus 20 Tier Skip Tokens.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell:[/b] Purchase BlackCell, and you automatically receive access to the Season 1 Battle Pass, plus 20 Tier Skip Tokens, as well as all earnable BlackCell content and other rewards detailed below.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Vault Edition:[/b] For players who purchase the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, in addition to all the other Vault Edition rewards, you gain access to all BlackCell and Battle Pass content, providing you log into the game during Season 1.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]How Does the Modern Warfare 4 Battle Pass Work?[/h3][p]The plan is straightforward: Simply play [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer, DMZ, or [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™, earning XP as you go, which levels up your Battle Pass from Tier 1 through 100.[/p][list][*][p]Simply earn Tiers through playing the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Battle Pass owners also receive a 10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the entire season, as a reward for purchasing the Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optionally use Tier Skip Tokens with COD Points to instantly claim any unlocked rewards.*[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optionally use Battle Pass 2XP Tokens you’ve acquired to quicken progress throughout the Battle Pass. Active XP Tokens are paused outside of matches.[/p][/*][/list][p]Auto Catch-up: Players who fall behind in the Battle Pass are automatically caught up to the Tier reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbaee6eedf8f60ecd81dc9fd4f8efc45f486989f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]*Tier Skip Tokens:[/b] Tier Skip Tokens allow you to access higher level rewards in the Battle Pass, unlocking content ahead of the next tier on the track. Players who purchase the Battle Pass Bundle can use their Tier Skip Tokens to access any of the 10 unlocked tiers ahead of their current position, while BlackCell users can grab rewards from up to 20 tiers ahead. Spending a Tier Skip Token on a higher tier reward will not change your in-progress position on the Battle Pass.[/p][p][/p][h3]What Type of Battle Pass Rewards Do I Earn?[/h3][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, and more, including new items such as DMZ Survival Kits. Expect to unlock the following as you progress through the Battle Pass:[/p][list][*][p]New Base Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Charms[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reticles[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Emblems[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Calling Cards[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Double XP Tokens (Player and Weapon Tokens)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Blueprints[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finishing Moves[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Equipment Skins[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Decals and Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sprays[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Survival Kits[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bonus Rewards (arriving mid-season; see later in this blog)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Season 1 BlackCell Offerings[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/777834124e8c33a70530ef87936e35125c88b9bf.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]The BlackCell faction is now active across all theaters of operations. BlackCell users will gain instant access to the “XERO” Skin and Operator, one of a trio of BlackCell Agents arriving in Season 1 under the name XERO. Complete BlackCell challenges to access two other XERO Skins: “Cowled” and “Adder.” The clandestine XERO leads a team of additional Operators clad in Skins and carrying Weapon Blueprints earned through BlackCell. [/p][p][/p][h3]Vault Edition Owners: BlackCell Access Granted![/h3][p]If you obtained the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, you can unlock this season’s BlackCell offering. [/p][p]If you obtained the Digital Standard Edition of Modern Warfare 4, you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]unlocking the many Vault Edition benefits detailed here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]What Type of BlackCell Rewards Do I Earn?[/h3][p]BlackCell owners get access to multiple rewards within the Season 1 Battle Pass, including:[/p][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Operator Skins for Blix (two Skins), Oh-Ji, Velikan, Min-Hee, Luca, and Dallas.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Weapon Blueprints for the Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Axion Assault Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle, ISO Nightshade SMG, CSG-35 SMG, Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle, and the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]BlackCell Multiplayer Lobby: Select any Operator from the BlackCell Faction, and your MP Lobby changes to the “Enigma Bunker”, reflecting a Black Site location within the faction’s operating facilities.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p][/p][h3]BlackCell DMZ Benefits[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6965f6a66e27dbcf81df57ddcc137ababd22d65.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Gain extra benefits in DMZ as a Season 1 BlackCell user, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]FOB:[/b] Extra Vendor Weapon and Equipment Slots: The Vendor in the Forward Operating Base (FOB) carries an additional weapon for purchase, and up to four pieces of Equipment, available to BlackCell. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Daily Rewards:[/b] Every 24 hours, a new reward — such as Printer Ingredients like Rigid Synthetics — will arrive in the FOB.0020These items are available to BlackCell users. Note that these rewards do not stack; any uncollected reward is lost when the next day’s reward cycles in, so visit the FOB BlackCell Bunker entrance daily to acquire your maximum quotient of rewards. Access the rewards at the DMZ Bunker, which are automatically deposited into your survival kit menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FOB Visual Upgrades:[/b] Players who own BlackCell will see upgraded tent materials and visuals throughout the FOB. The upgraded structures will remain visible as long as the player owns BlackCell.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell Weapon Manuals:[/b] For each BlackCell Weapon Blueprint you earn in the Battle Pass, you unlock the ability to craft the Blueprint’s base weapon in the DMZ Gunsmith.* [/p][/*][/list][p][b]*DMZ Weapon Manuals[/b] are also granted in the following two instances:[/p][list][*][p]When you [b]first unlock a new season’s free Base Weapons within the Battle Pass[/b] (in this case, the Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you purchase a [b]Store Bundle with a Weapon Blueprint[/b], a Weapon Manual for the base version of the Blueprint is also acquired.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]All other Blueprints[/b] you secure (for example, via the Battle Pass or a Store Bundle, whether you own BlackCell or not) allow you to use the Blueprint in DMZ until you fail to exfil with it, after which you can rebuy the Blueprint at a discount.[/p][p][/p][h2]Battle Pass Initial Access: Instant Rewards[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3738c31cb161c6709ff649b788f541ce538484ab.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]No matter how you obtain the Season 1 Battle Pass, you gain access to the new catch-up system described above and immediately unlock the following Instant Rewards:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d2c6e00217cd073936642422ee08e60bdfd44988.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the duration of Season 1[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Up to 1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Downpour” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Downpour BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fortune’s Favor” FiNN LMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Happy Boom” Frag Grenade Lethal Equipment Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Killing Demon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: “Ballistic Gel Armor Kit” DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]BlackCell Initial Access: Instant Rewards[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e48bcf6ce64f6839b3a85146e3cfcada9cd54913.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Purchase BlackCell to immediately unlocks a variety of Instant Rewards, kicking off your season on a high note with access to the following items:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d922913e02961065fb0fe7a9b7ee145e27a2676.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The “XERO” BlackCell Operator plus the “Cowled” and “Adder” Operator Skin variants available via BlackCell Challenges[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Perimeter Lance” M4 Assault Rifle Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint the “Occultus” and “Exitium” additional Signature Weapon Blueprint variants available via BlackCell Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dog Food” Companion Finishing Move, along with Dog Pet Companion that appears with your Operator in the Multiplayer Lobby when this Finishing Move is selected. Expect the dog to appear in the DMZ FOB at mid-season.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]MP: The Custom “Enigma Bunker” BlackCell Lobby Scene[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]BlackCell Mastery Camo Track (see below)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]20 Tier Skip Tokens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “BlackCell” Call Sign Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and during Match After Action Reports)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: “Advanced Triage Kit” DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Operator Skin and Weapon Blueprint Challenges[/h3][p]Expand your BlackCell Agent roster and Blueprint collection by completing in-game challenges to unlock two additional XERO Operator Skins and two additional M4 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprints. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b7133828aac02b128fa5b28eb16ba5acb17fc738.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Track your challenge progress in-game and complete the following challenges:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Challenge One: Kills[/b][/p][p]Reward: “Cowled” Operator Skin for XERO and “Occultus” M4 AR Blueprint[/p][p]Criteria: Obtain 3,000 Points.[/p][list][*][p]MP: 1 Kill = 5 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: 1 Kill (Enemy or Operator) = 2 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: 1 kill = 15 Points[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Challenge Two: Victories[/b][/p][p]Reward: “Adder Operator Skin for XERO and “Exitium” M4 AR Blueprint[/p][p]Criteria: Obtain 100 Points.[/p][list][*][p]MP: 1 Match Win = 10 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: 1 successful Exfil = 20 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: 5 kills without dying = 10 Points[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6f175b4675d4c7c85bc71aa5e19811c3edfeede.jpg"][/img][b]BlackCell Camo Track:[/b] Access the Season 1 BlackCell Mastery Camo track, offering additional BlackCell Weapon Camos for BlackCell users who complete various in-game weapon challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Challenge Three: Weapon Camos[/b][/p][p]Reward: Six Weapon Camos[/p][p]Criteria: Complete the Challenge for each Weapon Camo. After completion, the Weapon Camo can be applied to any weapon. Complete the following with any weapon within the class:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Assault Rifles Reward: “Infiltrator” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 10 double kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Get 20 triple kills  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 25 kills with ground loot[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SMGs Reward: “Cell Ops” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 20 point-blank kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Get 200 kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 10 hipfire kills[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sniper Rifles Reward: “Gold Tiger” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 3 kills without dying 5 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Get 100 headshot kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 10 headshot kills[/p][/*][/list][p][b]LMGs Reward: “Whirlpool” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 30 longshot kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Get 5 kills without reloading 10 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 2 kills without dying 10 times[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Melee Reward: “Intercept” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 3 kills in a single match 3 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Get 50 kills while undetected[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 5 eliminations while in the top 10[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Mastery Reward: “Spinal Verge” Camo[/b][/p][p]Unlock criteria: Complete all the Season 1 BlackCell weapon class-based challenges.[/p][p]Challenge:[/p][list][*][p]MP: Place 1st on the scoreboard 3 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Exfil with over 150 kills 5 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 2 kills within 10 seconds 10 times[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe54e074533e62aef52c086a0fa5495becf8160b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]BlackCell Bonus: Extra Daily Challenges:[/b] As well as the BlackCell “Enigma Bunker” Lobby, accessed in Multiplayer when a BlackCell Agent is selected, and a Pet Companion when the “Dog Food” Finishing Move is selected (shown above) BlackCell owners additionally get access to additional Daily Challenges throughout Season 1 for Multiplayer and Call of Duty: Warzone. BlackCell Daily Challenges count toward the three challenges required to earn Daily Challenge Bonus XP.[/p][p][/p][h2]Season 1: Main Battle Pass and BlackCell Operators[/h2][p]Get more intel on featured Season 1 Operators Blix and XERO, who both excel in the art of stealth and precision.[/p][p][/p][h3]Blix (Battle Pass, Launch)[/h3][p][i]Battle Pass Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/663e713dd333a166773992ecdd870c6dc18f6726.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A former South Korean Special Warfare Command operator, Blix was captured during a covert border mission and held for years. After surviving imprisonment, he was transferred through a network of foreign captives and deployed into proxy conflicts.[/p][p]War reshaped his view of combat into an absolute doctrine. He began tattooing survival codes and tactical principles across his skin, turning himself into a living archive. His mechanical efficiency and indifference to pain drew the attention of masked mercenary leader Nikto, who recruited him as a premier operative. Now in the Exclusion Zone, Blix carries out each objective with silent, disciplined precision.[/p][p][/p][h3]XERO (BlackCell, Launch)[/h3][p][i]BlackCell Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9db769ab74821cfab0c0b581407011f71b07b318.jpg"][/img][/p][p]BlackCell has no record of XERO before a classified development program involving behavioral conditioning, synthetic identities, and experimental combat training. His designation traces back to X-0, an internal prototype number later replaced by a single name: XERO.[/p][p]Field personnel describe him as unnervingly controlled, with flashes of memory tied to places and people absent from his official history. BlackCell refuses to explain them. Some believe his identity was erased; others suspect he was assembled from failed subjects. One theory is more disturbing: BlackCell created XERO’s past where none existed.[/p][p]Now deployed when an operation requires complete deniability, XERO remains one of BlackCell’s most closely controlled assets.[/p][p][/p][h2]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell: Content Deep Dive[/h2][p]Here’s all the Intel you need related to the types of Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell rewards:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d4fc5f5fb22d50b17d8e076019c4e9ca62e8998a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Battle Pass: New Base Weapons[/h3][p]Down targets with lightning speed with two new Battle Pass base weapons that bring the highest fire rate to their respective weapon classes: the Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: Cronen Osprey (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Tier 16, Tier 87 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf3b2fc5b0b3776b7e3bfb262d9b138986767e49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 70[/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 30[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 90[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 882 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Battle Pass.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Ammunition, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][i]Precision-engineered for relentless performance, this 5.56 rifle delivers a best-in-class fire rate without sacrificing control, accuracy, or mobility.[/i][/p][p]Featuring the fastest fire rate in its weapon class, the Cronen Osprey chews up enemy targets fast while maintaining accuracy on target so long as you’re able to counter its recoil kick up and to the right. Use burst fire and Attachments that improve vertical recoil control to help stay on target and consider a higher round Magazine if you find yourself running through your ammo reserves too quickly.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: Cronen Helix Mk.II[/b][/p][p][i]A unique double-barrel receiver transforms this 5.56 rifle into a dual-fire weapon platform. Firing on both trigger pull and release, it delivers punishing damage with an unmatched rate of fire among semi-automatic weapons.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: CSG-35 (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]SMG, Battle Pass Tier 36, Tier 73 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c8d77300a77f83ac45019cf284f739af86d07bea.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 42[/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 28[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 112[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 1200 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Battle Pass.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Ammunition, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][i]A highly mobile conceal-and-carry SMG that pairs maneuverability with a best-in-class rate of fire. Fast, compact, and lethal in tight spaces.[/i][/p][p]Another rapid-fire option that beats out the other SMGs in spitting out rounds, the CSG-35 is the perfect tool for clearing enemy targets up close. Use its strong mobility and handling characteristics to get into position fast and let loose with a blazing attack. Ideal for breaching and flanking tactics that bring you toe to toe with the enemy. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: CSG Crossfire[/b][/p][p][i]Dual-wield akimbo CSG-35 SMGs and trade accuracy for a wave of downrange chaos.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Battle Pass and BlackCell Operator Skins[/h3][p]In addition to multiple skins for main Battle Pass Operator Blix, and main BlackCell Operator XERO, the following Operator Skins are available:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oh-Ji “Nocturn” Skins[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 10[/b][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 10[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e190e224fa6c78075141851809f6fbab2025f88b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Take combat into the wilderness with Oh-Ji’s ghillie suited get-up.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Velikan “Old Guard” Skins[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 22[/b][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 22[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1a5d8bbf3470e4f527c2b22400501dd4b79adfd0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Don heavy armor, night vision goggles, and a helmet baring the fangs of a ferocious predator.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Min-Hee “Patience” Skins[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 43[/b][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 43[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b05652323642b009402dcfd42b61414587b17719.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Disappear into the foliage and attack from a stealth position with this camouflaged outfit that blends in with the surrounding wilderness.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oh-Ji “Shizen” Skin[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 45[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33045a2efcc9dda8fd2e1489845362c0a8c43b9b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Overcome all obstacles en route to the enemy encampment with this low-profile uniform outfitted with a variety of survival tools.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Simone “Collision” Skin[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 52[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d983498e34de64f640db9148cecfe25f6c08011c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Represent Shadow Company in this navy-blue PMC uniform geared for both combat and rescue operations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Luca “Feral Bite” Skins[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 58[/b][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 58[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d52b6ac4862566632eaddc3c0ec55df93c82b8b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Luca prepares for heated combat with heavy armor plates and gear designed to withstand the most punishing attacks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Valen “Red Eclipse” Skin[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 71[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cbb96646e000297578ee95dd4810121dfd724baf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Survive even the most chaotic battleground with this uniform combining stealth, heavy armor, and enough ammo to outlast even the toughest firefights.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dallas “Dour” Skins[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 81[/b][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 81[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/87d7ec45ec1be8fdab06869455b18527c7c04dff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Equipped with comms gear, ammo, and breaching tools, Dallas is ready to take on the toughest Shadow Company missions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]US Special Forces “Naval Special Warfare Classic” Skin[/b][/p][p][b]Battle Pass Operator Skin:[/b] [b]Tier 85[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/60b8d7776ec1497a04a5045b696b90fa524d5c5c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For players seeking a pristine Mil-Sim experience, look no further than this camouflaged uniform with face paint designed to blend in with the underbrush.[/p][p][/p][h3]Battle Pass and BlackCell Weapon Blueprints[/h3][p]In addition to the Weapon Blueprints unlocked as part of the BlackCell and Battle Pass
